bibl.seg: Alexander Belov, with a contribution by Catherine Grataloup, Ship 17: a baris from Thonis-Heracleion = Oxford Centre for Maritime Archaeology Monograph. 10. Ships and boats of the Canopic Region in Egypt. 1.
Oxford, School of Archaeology, University of Oxford, 2019, 140 pp., figg. ISBN 978-1-905905-36-2. £45.
C.R. par Patrice Pomey, IJNA 49 (2020) pp. 211-212.
bibl.note: Introduction. - Part I. Egyptian naval architecture of the Late Period and new evidence from ship 17: 1. Egyptian shipbuilding during the Late Period; - 2. The context and date of ship 17. - Part II: The construction of ship 17: 3. The species of wood used; - 4. Longitudinal structure; - 5. Planking; - 6. Transversal structure; - 7. The steering system; - 8. The remains of the rigging. - Part III. The construction sequence, vessel type and technical evaluations of the hull: 9. The construction sequence; - 10. Typology of ship 17 and its zone of operation; - 11. The main characteristics of the hull. - Conclusion. - Glossary. Bibliography. Index.
